en.title: C
en.summary: The letter C is a consonant in the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter name sounds like /k/ or /tʃ/. Its main sound appears in (casă) /kasp/, which means house. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: Mouth and voice
paragraphs: Raise the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Block the air, then release it quickly without your voice. For the other sound, press your tongue behind your top front teeth. Push the air through as your tongue drops. Hold your hand on your neck to feel no vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: You pronounce the sound /k/ before consonants and before most vowels, as in (cald) /kald/. You pronounce the sound /tʃ/ when the letter stands before e or i, as in (ceai) /tʃaj/ and (cinci) /tʃintʃ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add a strong puff of air. Keep the sound crisp, unlike the sound in kite. Never soften the letter into an s sound before front vowels.
